summary.en: A baffling and seemingly impossible murder is committed at a secluded Mount Takao temple. Luckily Conan and Kogoro are on the scene. It is believed that the terrible Mist Goblin (Kiritengu), a creature with super strength, haunts the temple. Conan doesn't believe in goblins, but he may have to change his tune as the evidence suggests that the Mist Goblin may be more than just a legend. Location: Sandei Temple Cause of death: Hanging Location: Sandei Temple Victim: Priest Tenei Cause of death: Hanging Suspects: Kannen, Tonnen, Mokunen, and Shunen Priest Tenei was found hanged dead, the same way Chunen was found two years ago.
summary.zhHans: 以寺院传说和密室现象为核心的早期案件，柯南需要在传说叙事与现场证据之间建立对应关系。
